data.body_html:
Planning a Valentine's Day proposal on a boat in Marbella is the ultimate romantic gesture. With the Mediterranean glittering under a winter sunset and the iconic La Concha mountain as your backdrop, a private charter offers intimacy, luxury, and a memory that will last a lifetime. Whether you choose a sleek Astondoa 40 or a show-stopping Mangusta 80, this guide walks you through every step — from budget and boat selection to timing, extras, and booking tips. Let's make your 'yes' unforgettable.

Why Choose a Boat for Your Valentine's Day Proposal?

A boat proposal combines privacy, scenery, and exclusivity. Unlike a crowded restaurant or beach, a private charter gives you complete control over the moment. You can anchor at a secluded cove like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, pop the question as the sun dips below the horizon, and celebrate with champagne and cava — all included in your charter. Plus, with a licensed skipper at the helm, you can focus entirely on your partner.

Best Boats for a Valentine's Day Proposal

Our fleet offers options for every style and budget. For an intimate two-hour charter, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are perfect — both priced at €749 for 2 hours, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. If you want to go all out, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski for post-proposal fun. For a smaller, cosy vibe, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are available on request. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Timing Your Proposal: Sunset and Season

In February, sunset in Marbella occurs around 18:30. For the perfect golden hour light, book a charter from 16:30 to 18:30 or 17:00 to 19:00. This gives you 30–45 minutes of soft, warm light before the sun dips behind La Concha. The average temperature in February is 16–18°C, so bring a light jacket. After sunset, the lights of Puerto Banús and Marbella's Golden Mile create a magical evening atmosphere.

What's Included in Your Charter?

Every boat rental includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water and soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. Spanish IVA (21%) is already included in the price. You can also add extras like a bouquet of roses, a bottle of premium champagne, or a private photographer to capture the moment. Contact us via WhatsApp after booking to arrange these.

How to Customise Your Proposal

Beyond the standard inclusions, we can help you tailor every detail. Popular additions include:

  • Rose petals scattered on the deck or cabin
  • A 'Will you marry me?' banner or balloon arch
  • A private chef serving a multi-course dinner
  • Live acoustic guitar or a curated playlist via the boat's sound system
  • A hidden GoPro or drone footage (with prior arrangement)

We recommend discussing your vision at least one week in advance to ensure availability.

Departure Points and Itineraries

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, the iconic marina lined with luxury yachts and designer boutiques. From there, you can cruise along the coast towards Marbella Marina, Cabopino, or Estepona. Popular proposal spots include the secluded Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, where you can anchor in crystal-clear waters. For a shorter trip, a loop around the Río Verde area offers stunning views of the Golden Mile mansions.

Booking Tips for Valentine's Day

Valentine's Day is our busiest period — book at least 2 weeks in advance to secure your preferred boat and time slot. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are the most popular for proposals due to their affordable price and intimate size. If you're planning a surprise, consider telling only the skipper your plan — we'll help coordinate the timing and location discreetly. For larger groups (up to 12 pax), the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 Flybridge offer ample space.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best boat for a Valentine's Day proposal in Marbella?

For an intimate proposal, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) offers a cosy 12.5m deck with space for 9 guests. For a grand gesture, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski and luxurious 24m layout. Both depart from Puerto Banús.

How much does a Valentine's Day boat rental in Marbella cost?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. The Mangusta 80 requires a minimum 4-hour booking at €4,719. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What is included in the charter?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You can add champagne, flowers, or a private chef for an extra fee.

Can I propose at sunset on a boat in Marbella?

Absolutely. In February, sunset is around 18:30. We recommend a 2-hour charter from 16:30 to 18:30 or 17:00 to 19:00. The views over La Concha and the Mediterranean provide a stunning backdrop.

Which departure points are available for Valentine's Day charters?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús. You can also arrange pickups from Marbella Marina, Cabopino, or Estepona on request. Puerto Banús offers the most iconic setting with its luxury yachts and waterfront restaurants.

How far in advance should I book for Valentine's Day?

We recommend booking at least 2 weeks ahead, as Valentine's Day is our busiest period. Early booking ensures you get your preferred boat, time slot, and any custom extras like roses or a photographer.

Can I decorate the boat for a proposal?

Yes, we can arrange decorations such as rose petals, balloons, banners, or a custom 'Will you marry me?' sign. Contact us via WhatsApp after booking to discuss your vision and any additional costs.

What happens if the weather is bad on Valentine's Day?

Your safety is our priority. If weather conditions are unsafe, we will offer you a full refund or reschedule to another date. We monitor forecasts closely and notify you 24 hours in advance if changes are needed.
